title: Ganitha Mela at VITM, Bengaluru
location: Visvesvaraya Industrial and Technological Museum, Bengaluru
teaser: Ganitha Mela (Mathematics Fair) at VITM, Bengaluru, on 22 December 2025, as part of National Mathematics Day celebrations organised by tAcT, Seed2Sapling, VITM-NCSM, and IISER Tirupati.
homepageMatter: tAcT, Seed2Sapling Education, VITM-NCSM, and IISER Tirupati organised a Ganitha Mela (Mathematics Fair) at VITM, Bengaluru, on 22 December 2025. Schools participated with activity stalls, demonstrations, and Harate sessions demonstrating concepts like Fibonacci sequences and Hilbert Hotel.
